            backBtn.IsEnabled = currentStep == 2;

            if (currentStep == 1)
            {
                stepEyebrow.Text = "STEP 1 OF 3 • SELECT CLASSIC STOREFILES";
                stepTitle.Text = "Choose Classic .stf Profiles to Upgrade";
                nextBtn.Content = "Next →";
            }
            else if (currentStep == 2)
            {
                var chosen = checkBoxes.Where(c => c.IsChecked == true).Select(c => (string)c.Tag).ToList();
                stepEyebrow.Text = "STEP 2 OF 3 • READY TO UPGRADE";
                stepTitle.Text = "Review Upgrade Plan";
                nextBtn.Content = $"Upgrade {chosen.Count} Profile(s) →";

                var lines = new List<string>
                {
                    $"Destination Folder:  {destinationStoreFilesFolder}",
                    "Original .stf Files: Preserved 100% untouched (StoreTrainer 1.0 & 1.1 remain fully compatible)",
                    "",
                    $"Profiles Selected ({chosen.Count}):"
                };
                foreach (var f in chosen)
                {
                    lines.Add($"  • {Path.GetFileName(f)}  -->  {Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(f)}.stfx");
                }
                step2Box.Text = string.Join(Environment.NewLine, lines);
            }
            else
            {
                stepEyebrow.Text = "STEP 3 OF 3 • UPGRADE COMPLETE";
                stepTitle.Text = "StoreFile Upgrade Summary Report";
                nextBtn.Content = "Finish";
                cancelBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                backBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                if (createdPaths.Count == 1)
                {
                    launchBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                }
            }
        }

        backBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (currentStep == 2)
            {
                currentStep = 1;
                RenderStepState();
            }
        };

        nextBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (currentStep == 1)
            {
                var chosen = checkBoxes.Where(c => c.IsChecked == true).ToList();
                if (chosen.Count == 0)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show(dlg, "Please select at least one classic .stf file to upgrade.", "Select StoreFile", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
                    return;
                }
                currentStep = 2;
                RenderStepState();
            }
            else if (currentStep == 2)
            {
                var chosenPaths = checkBoxes.Where(c => c.IsChecked == true).Select(c => (string)c.Tag).ToList();
                var reportLines = new List<string>();
                var okCount = 0;
                var errCount = 0;

                foreach (var src in chosenPaths)
                {
                    var item = service.UpgradeClassicStfToStfx(src, destinationStoreFilesFolder);
                    if (item.Success)
                    {
                        okCount++;
                        createdPaths.Add(item.OutputStfxPath);
                        reportLines.Add($"✅ {item.DisplayTitle}");
                        reportLines.Add($"   Source:  {item.SourceStfPath}");
                        reportLines.Add($"   Created: {item.OutputStfxPath}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        errCount++;
                        reportLines.Add($"⚠️ {item.DisplayTitle} (Failed)");
                    }

                    foreach (var n in item.Notes)
                    {
                        reportLines.Add($"   {n}");
                    }
                    reportLines.Add(string.Empty);
                }

                reportLines.Insert(0, $"Summary: {okCount} upgraded, {errCount} error(s)" + Environment.NewLine);
                step3Box.Text = string.Join(Environment.NewLine, reportLines);
                currentStep = 3;
                RenderStepState();
            }
            else
            {
                dlg.DialogResult = true;
                dlg.Close();
            }
        };

        launchBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            launchImmediately = true;
            dlg.DialogResult = true;
            dlg.Close();
        };

        cancelBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            dlg.DialogResult = false;
            dlg.Close();
        };

        dlg.Content = root;
        _ = dlg.ShowDialog();
        return new StoreFileUpgradeWizardOutcome(createdPaths, launchImmediately);
    }

    // =========================================================================

    public static TrainerZipDialogChoice? ShowTrainerZipExtractDialog(
        Window owner,
        string zipFilePath,

    {
        var hasGameFolder = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gameFolderPath) && Directory.Exists(gameFolderPath);
        TrainerZipDialogChoice? choice = null;

        var dlg = new Window
        {
            Title = $"Extract Trainer Archive — {Path.GetFileName(zipFilePath)}",
            Owner = owner,
            Width = 620,
            SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Height,

            WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner
        };
        AutomationProperties.SetName(dlg, "Extract Trainer ZIP Archive");

        root.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {

        });

        var docsSummary = inspection.ReadmeAndNfoEntries.Count > 0

            : string.Empty;

        });

        var exeCombo = new ComboBox
        {

            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 14)
        };
        root.Children.Add(exeCombo);

        root.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = "2. Where should StoreTrainer extract this trainer?",

            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 6)
        });

        var radioGameDir = new RadioButton
        {
            GroupName = "ZipDest",
            IsEnabled = hasGameFolder,

            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 8),
            Content = new TextBlock
            {
                Text = hasGameFolder
                    ? $"Extract directly into the game's folder:\n{gameFolderPath}\n(Recommended for classic trainers — Windows will ask administrator permission if the game is in Program Files)"
                    : "Extract directly into the game's folder (choose a Game Program first to enable this option)",
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap
            }
        };

        var radioLibraryDir = new RadioButton
        {
            GroupName = "ZipDest",
            IsChecked = !hasGameFolder,
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 16),
            Content = new TextBlock
            {
                Text = $"Extract into my StoreFiles\\Trainers folder:\n{defaultTrainersSubfolder}\n(Keeps your game installation folder untouched; no administrator permission needed)",
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap
            }
        };

        root.Children.Add(radioGameDir);
        root.Children.Add(radioLibraryDir);

        var footer = new DockPanel { LastChildFill = false };
        var cancelBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "Cancel",
            Padding = new Thickness(16, 7, 16, 7),
            IsCancel = true
        };
        var extractBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "📦 Extract Trainer",
            FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
            Padding = new Thickness(18, 7, 18, 7),
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0),
            IsDefault = true
        };
        DockPanel.SetDock(cancelBtn, Dock.Right);
        DockPanel.SetDock(extractBtn, Dock.Right);
        footer.Children.Add(cancelBtn);
        footer.Children.Add(extractBtn);
        root.Children.Add(footer);

        extractBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            var selectedExe = exeCombo.SelectedItem as string ?? inspection.ExecutableEntries[0];

        dlg.Content = root;
        _ = dlg.ShowDialog();
        return choice;
    }

    public static Window ShowHotkeyCheatCardWindow(Window? owner, StoreFileProfile profile)
    {
        var win = new Window
        {
            Title = $"Cheat Card — {profile.DisplayTitle}",
            Width = 370,
            Height = 460,
            MinWidth = 290,
            MinHeight = 260,
            Topmost = true,
            WindowStartupLocation = owner is not null ? WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner : WindowStartupLocation.Manual
        };
        AutomationProperties.SetName(win, $"Floating Shortcut Cheat Card for {profile.DisplayTitle}");

        var grid = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(14) };
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });

        var header = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10) };
        header.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = $"🎮 {profile.DisplayTitle}",
            FontSize = 15.5,
            FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap
        });

        var pinCheck = new CheckBox
        {
            Content = "📌 Keep pinned above other windows (Always on Top)",
            IsChecked = true,
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0)
        };
        pinCheck.Checked += (_, _) => win.Topmost = true;
        pinCheck.Unchecked += (_, _) => win.Topmost = false;
        header.Children.Add(pinCheck);
        Grid.SetRow(header, 0);
        grid.Children.Add(header);

        var contentStack = new StackPanel();
        if (profile.Hotkeys.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (var hk in profile.Hotkeys.Where(h => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(h.Keys) || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(h.Effect)))
            {
                var row = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 6) };
                row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(115) });
                row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });

                var keyBadge = new Border
                {
                    CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(4),
                    BorderThickness = new Thickness(1),
                    BorderBrush = Brushes.Gray,
                    Padding = new Thickness(7, 3, 7, 3),
                    Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0),
                    Child = new TextBlock
                    {
                        Text = hk.Keys,
                        FontFamily = new FontFamily("Consolas, Segoe UI"),
                        FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
                        FontSize = 12
                    }
                };
                Grid.SetColumn(keyBadge, 0);
                row.Children.Add(keyBadge);

                var desc = new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = hk.Effect,
                    VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
                    TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                    FontSize = 12.5
                };
                Grid.SetColumn(desc, 1);
                row.Children.Add(desc);
                contentStack.Children.Add(row);
            }
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.Notes))
        {
            contentStack.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = "Personal Notes:",
                FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
                FontSize = 12.5,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 4)
            });
            contentStack.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = profile.Notes,
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                FontSize = 12.5,
                Opacity = 0.9
            });
        }

        if (profile.Hotkeys.Count == 0 && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.Notes))
        {
            contentStack.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = "No shortcut keys or notes added yet.\n\nAdd rows in the Shortcut Cheat Table (or click 'View .NFO' to auto-import keys from your trainer's info file)!",
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                Opacity = 0.78,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 12, 0, 0)
            });
        }

        var scroll = new ScrollViewer
        {
            VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
            Content = contentStack
        };
        Grid.SetRow(scroll, 1);
        grid.Children.Add(scroll);

        var closeBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "Close Cheat Card",
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right,
            Padding = new Thickness(14, 6, 14, 6),
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 10, 0, 0)
        };
        closeBtn.Click += (_, _) => win.Close();
        Grid.SetRow(closeBtn, 2);
        grid.Children.Add(closeBtn);

        win.Content = grid;
        win.Show(); // Modeless so the user can play their game while keeping this card visible!
        return win;
    }

    public static void ShowSaveBackupsDialog(
        Window owner,
        StoreTrainerService service,
        StoreFileProfile profile)
    {
        var dlg = new Window
        {
            Title = $"Save-Game Backups — {profile.DisplayTitle}",
            Owner = owner,
            Width = 600,
            Height = 450,
            MinWidth = 480,
            MinHeight = 360,
            WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner
        };
        AutomationProperties.SetName(dlg, "Manage Save-Game Backups");

        var grid = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(20) };
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });

        var header = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10) };
        header.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = $"🛡 Save-Game Backups for {profile.DisplayTitle}",
            FontSize = 16.5,
            FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold
        });
        header.Children.Add(new TextBlock
        {
            Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.SaveFolderPath)
                ? "Choose this game's Save-Game Folder in the profile editor first to create 1-click backups."
                : $"Save Folder: {profile.SaveFolderPath}",
            FontSize = 12,
            Opacity = 0.82,
            TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0)
        });
        Grid.SetRow(header, 0);
        grid.Children.Add(header);

        var listBox = new ListBox
        {
            DisplayMemberPath = nameof(SaveBackupInfo.FriendlyLabel),
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 12)
        };
        Grid.SetRow(listBox, 1);
        grid.Children.Add(listBox);

        void RefreshList()
        {
            listBox.ItemsSource = service.ListSaveGameBackups(profile);
            if (listBox.Items.Count > 0)
            {
                listBox.SelectedIndex = 0;
            }
        }
        RefreshList();

        var footer = new WrapPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right };
        var backupNowBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "➕ Backup Saves Now",
            FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold,
            Padding = new Thickness(12, 6, 12, 6),
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0),
            IsEnabled = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.SaveFolderPath) && Directory.Exists(profile.SaveFolderPath)
        };
        var restoreBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "⏪ Restore Selected Backup",
            Padding = new Thickness(12, 6, 12, 6),
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0)
        };
        var openFolderBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "📂 Backups Folder",
            Padding = new Thickness(12, 6, 12, 6),
            Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0)
        };
        var doneBtn = new Button
        {
            Content = "Done",
            Padding = new Thickness(16, 6, 16, 6),
            IsDefault = true,
            IsCancel = true
        };

        backupNowBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            try
            {
                var snap = service.CreateSaveGameBackup(profile);
                RefreshList();
                MessageBox.Show(dlg, $"Created save-game snapshot:\n{snap.FriendlyLabel}", "Backup Created", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(dlg, $"Could not create backup:\n{ex.Message}", "Backup Notice", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
        };

        restoreBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (listBox.SelectedItem is not SaveBackupInfo selected)
            {
                return;
            }
            var ask = MessageBox.Show(
                dlg,
                $"Restore save-game snapshot from {selected.CreatedLocalTime:MMM d, yyyy h:mm tt} into:\n{profile.SaveFolderPath}?",
                "Restore Save-Game Backup",
                MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
                MessageBoxImage.Question,
                MessageBoxResult.No);
            if (ask != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                service.RestoreSaveGameBackup(selected.ZipFilePath, profile.SaveFolderPath);
                MessageBox.Show(dlg, "Save-game files restored!", "Restore Complete", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(dlg, $"Could not restore backup:\n{ex.Message}", "Restore Notice", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
        };

        openFolderBtn.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            try
            {
                Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
                {
                    FileName = service.GetSaveBackupsDirectoryForProfile(profile),
                    UseShellExecute = true
                });
            }
            catch { /* ignore */ }
        };

        doneBtn.Click += (_, _) => dlg.Close();

        footer.Children.Add(backupNowBtn);
        footer.Children.Add(restoreBtn);
        footer.Children.Add(openFolderBtn);
        footer.Children.Add(doneBtn);
        Grid.SetRow(footer, 2);
        grid.Children.Add(footer);

        dlg.Content = grid;
        _ = dlg.ShowDialog();
    }
}

Cp437NfoHelper.cs (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Classic Trainer .NFO Reader & Shortcut Importer)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Renders classic trainer .nfo and file_id.diz ASCII art cleanly and detects shortcut key rows automatically.

// ================================================================================
// FILE: Cp437NfoHelper.cs
// PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
// LICENSE: MIT License
//
// PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
//   Why do classic PC game trainer '.nfo' and 'file_id.diz' files look scrambled
//   when you open them in modern Windows Notepad?
//     In the 1990s and 2000s, trainer release groups drew elaborate ASCII borders
//     and shading using **IBM PC Code Page 437 (CP437)** — the original 8-bit
//     character set burned into IBM VGA graphics cards (where bytes 128–255 represent
//     box-drawing corners '╔══╗', shade blocks '░▒▓█', and symbols). Modern editors
//     assume UTF-8, turning those bytes into '' replacement diamonds!
//
//   What does this helper do (with ZERO external NuGet packages)?
//     1. 'ReadNfoText(filePath)': Checks if a file is valid UTF-8; if not, maps
//        every byte 0–255 through the exact IBM PC CP437 Unicode lookup table so
//        classic '.nfo' / '.diz' art renders crisp and authentic!
//     2. 'ExtractHotkeysFromText(nfoText)': Scans the '.nfo' or 'readme.txt' lines
//        for trainer shortcut patterns (like 'Numpad 1 ... Infinite Health',
//        'F1 - God Mode', or '[Ctrl + 2] : Unlimited Gold') and turns them straight
//        into structured 'HotkeyItem' rows for your Cheat Card!
// ================================================================================

using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using StoreTrainer.Models;

namespace StoreTrainer.Services;

public static partial class Cp437NfoHelper
{
    // Exact 128-character Unicode mapping for IBM PC Code Page 437 upper bytes (0x80..0xFF).
    private static readonly char[] Cp437HighTable =
    [
        'Ç', 'ü', 'é', 'â', 'ä', 'à', 'å', 'ç', 'ê', 'ë', 'è', 'ï', 'î', 'ì', 'Ä', 'Å',
        'É', 'æ', 'Æ', 'ô', 'ö', 'ò', 'û', 'ù', 'ÿ', 'Ö', 'Ü', '¢', '£', '¥', '₧', 'ƒ',
        'á', 'í', 'ó', 'ú', 'ñ', 'Ñ', 'ª', 'º', '¿', '⌐', '¬', '½', '¼', '¡', '«', '»',
        '░', '▒', '▓', '│', '┤', '╡', '╢', '╖', '╕', '╣', '║', '╗', '╝', '╜', '╛', '┐',
        '└', '┴', '┬', '├', '─', '┼', '╞', '╟', '╚', '╔', '╩', '╦', '╠', '═', '╬', '╧',
        '╨', '╤', '╥', '╙', '╘', '╒', '╓', '╫', '╪', '┘', '┌', '█', '▄', '▌', '▐', '▀',
        'α', 'ß', 'Γ', 'π', 'Σ', 'σ', 'µ', 'τ', 'Φ', 'Θ', 'Ω', 'δ', '∞', 'φ', 'ε', '∩',
        '≡', '±', '≥', '≤', '⌠', '⌡', '÷', '≈', '°', '∙', '·', '√', 'ⁿ', '²', '■', '\u00A0'
    ];

    // IBM PC CP437 graphical glyphs for control bytes 0x01..0x1F (excluding \t, \n, \r).
    private static readonly char[] Cp437LowGlyphs =
    [
        ' ', '☺', '☻', '♥', '♦', '♣', '♠', '•', '◘', '○', '◙', '♂', '♀', '♪', '♫', '☼',
        '►', '◄', '↕', '‼', '¶', '§', '▬', '↨', '↑', '↓', '→', '←', '∟', '↔', '▲', '▼'
    ];

    /// <summary>
    /// Reads a <c>.nfo</c>, <c>.diz</c>, or <c>.txt</c> file, decoding MS-DOS CP437 art cleanly.
    /// </summary>
    public static string ReadNfoText(string filePath)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filePath) || !File.Exists(filePath))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var rawBytes = File.ReadAllBytes(filePath);

        // If the file starts with a UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF), read it as UTF-8.
        if (rawBytes.Length >= 3 && rawBytes[0] == 0xEF && rawBytes[1] == 0xBB && rawBytes[2] == 0xBF)
        {
            return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(rawBytes, 3, rawBytes.Length - 3);
        }

        // For '.txt' files that happen to be valid strict UTF-8 without high-ASCII CP437 art, prefer UTF-8;
        // for '.nfo' and '.diz' files (or any file with invalid UTF-8 high bytes), decode via CP437!
        if (!filePath.EndsWith(".nfo", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            !filePath.EndsWith(".diz", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            try
            {
                var strictUtf8 = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true);
                return strictUtf8.GetString(rawBytes);
            }
            catch
            {
                // Fall through to authentic CP437 decoding!
            }
        }

        var sb = new StringBuilder(rawBytes.Length);
        foreach (var b in rawBytes)
        {
            if (b == 0x09 || b == 0x0A || b == 0x0D)
            {
                sb.Append((char)b);
            }
            else if (b < 0x20)
            {
                sb.Append(Cp437LowGlyphs[b]);
            }
            else if (b < 0x7F)
            {
                sb.Append((char)b);
            }
            else if (b == 0x7F)
            {
                sb.Append('⌂');
            }
            else
            {
                sb.Append(Cp437HighTable[b - 0x80]);
            }
        }
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    // Matches common trainer readme hotkey lines like:
    //   "Numpad 1   - Infinite Health"
    //   "[F2]       : Unlimited Ammo"
    //   "Ctrl+Num 3 ... Instant Build"
    [GeneratedRegex(
        @"^\s*[\[\(\*•│║]*\s*(?<key>(?:(?:Ctrl|Alt|Shift)\s*\+\s*)?(?:Num(?:pad)?\s*(?:[0-9\+\-\*/\.]|Add|Sub)|F(?:1[0-2]|[1-9])|Insert|Home|PgUp|PgDn|Delete|End|Backspace))\s*[\]\)]*\s*(?:[-:=~>]+|\.{2,})\s*(?<desc>[A-Za-z0-9][^\│║\r\n]{2,65})",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled)]
    private static partial Regex TrainerHotkeyLineRegex();

    /// <summary>
    /// Scans <c>.nfo</c> or <c>readme.txt</c> content and extracts clean hotkey/effect pairs.
    /// </summary>
    public static List<HotkeyItem> ExtractHotkeysFromText(string text)
    {
        var list = new List<HotkeyItem>();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
        {
            return list;
        }

        var seenKeys = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var rawLine in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            // Strip decorative outer CP437 border bars before matching
            var trimmed = rawLine.Trim('\r', ' ', '\t', '║', '│', '█', '▓', '▒', '░', '*');
            var match = TrainerHotkeyLineRegex().Match(trimmed);
            if (!match.Success)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var key = Regex.Replace(match.Groups["key"].Value.Trim(), @"\s+", " ");
            var desc = match.Groups["desc"].Value.Trim(' ', '\t', '.', '*', '║', '│');
            if (key.Length > 0 && desc.Length >= 3 && seenKeys.Add(key))
            {
                list.Add(new HotkeyItem
                {
                    Keys = key,
                    Effect = desc
                });
            }
        }

        return list;
    }
}

MainWindow.xaml (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Two-Column Library & Dual-Launch Editor Layout)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Accessible desktop layout with real game icons, Launch with Trainer vs. Launch Clean buttons, multi-trainer slots, and Light/Dark theme support.

<!--
================================================================================
FILE: MainWindow.xaml
PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)

PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
  What is this file?
    MainWindow.xaml defines the visual desktop window for RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0.
    Think of this XAML file like a responsive 4-row CSS Grid layout:
      - Row 0 (Top Header): Branding, Library Folder controls, Check for Updates,
        Theme switcher (System / Dark / Light), and About & Legal Notice.
      - Row 1 (Optional Classic Import Banner): Appears automatically if classic
        StoreTrainer 1.0/1.1 '.stf' profiles are detected in 'My StoreFiles',
        offering 1-click access to the 3-step StoreFile Upgrade Wizard!
      - Row 2 (Main Two-Column Workspace):
          * Left Sidebar: New Profile, Open / Upgrade Classic .stf, instant search,
            category filter, and a live list of '.stfx' profiles with real game icons!
          * Right Profile Editor & Launcher:
              - Dual Launch Bar: "▶ Launch with Trainer" AND "▶ Launch Clean (No Trainer)",
                plus Floating Cheat Card, Desktop Shortcut, Save, Duplicate, and Delete.
              - Card 1: Profile Name, Launch Order, Auto-Close Trainer on Game Exit,
                and Classic Game CPU Core Limiter.
              - Card 2: Game Program (drag-and-drop '.exe' support!).
              - Card 3: Multiple Companion Trainers per Game + "📦 Extract Trainer ZIP..."
                (with automatic Windows administrator prompt for Program Files!) +
                "📄 View Trainer Info (.NFO)" + Trusted Trainer Snapshot check.
              - Card 4: Pre-Launch Save-Game Backup & 1-Click Rollback ("Trainer Insurance").
              - Card 5: Structured Shortcut Key Cheat Table + Personal Notes + Pop-Out Cheat Card.
              - Mandatory RaggieSoft Work of Fiction & Creative Licensing notice.
      - Row 3 (Bottom Status Bar): Live status readout and active StoreFiles path.
================================================================================
-->
<Window x:Class="StoreTrainer.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer — PC Game &amp; Trainer Organizer"
        Icon="Assets/StoreTrainer.png"
        Width="1280"
        Height="860"
        MinWidth="900"
        MinHeight="620"
        AllowDrop="True"
        Drop="Window_OnDrop"
        DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        AutomationProperties.Name="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer Application">

    <Grid Margin="14">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
            <RowDefinition Height="*" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 0: TOP APPLICATION HEADER BAR
             =================================================================== -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0"
                Padding="16,11"
                CornerRadius="8"
                BorderThickness="1"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}"
                Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                <!-- Left Branding -->
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Image Source="Assets/StoreTrainer.png"
                           Width="40"
                           Height="40"
                           Margin="0,0,14,0"
                           RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality" />
                    <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer"
                                       FontSize="19"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            <Border CornerRadius="4"
                                    Padding="8,2"
                                    Margin="10,0,0,0"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                    VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="Version 2.0"
                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           Opacity="0.88" />
                            </Border>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="LibrarySummaryText"
                                   Text="Organize and launch your classic and modern PC games alongside their companion trainers"
                                   FontSize="12.5"
                                   Opacity="0.78"
                                   Margin="0,2,0,0" />
                    </StackPanel>
                </StackPanel>

                <!-- Right Header Actions -->
                <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Button x:Name="OpenLibraryFolderButton"
                            Content="📂 Open StoreFiles"
                            Padding="10,6"
                            Margin="0,0,7,0"
                            Click="OpenLibraryFolderButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Open your Documents\StoreFiles folder in File Explorer"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Open StoreFiles Folder" />
                    <Button x:Name="ChangeLibraryFolderButton"
                            Content="📁 Library Folder..."
                            Padding="10,6"
                            Margin="0,0,7,0"
                            Click="ChangeLibraryFolderButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Choose where your .stfx game profiles are stored"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Choose StoreFiles Library Folder" />
                    <Button x:Name="CheckUpdatesButton"
                            Content="🔄 Check for Updates"
                            Padding="10,6"
                            Margin="0,0,7,0"
                            Click="CheckUpdatesButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Check for updates across your installed RaggieSoft applications"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Check for Application Updates" />
                    <Button x:Name="ThemeToggleButton"
                            Content="🌓 Theme: System"
                            Padding="10,6"
                            Margin="0,0,7,0"
                            Click="ThemeToggleButton_OnClick"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Switch Color Theme" />
                    <Button Content="ℹ️ About &amp; Legal"
                            Padding="10,6"
                            Click="AboutAndLegalButton_OnClick"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="About RaggieSoft StoreTrainer and Work of Fiction Notice" />
                </WrapPanel>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 1: NON-DESTRUCTIVE CLASSIC 'MY STOREFILES' (.STF) UPGRADE BANNER
             =================================================================== -->
        <Border x:Name="ClassicImportBannerBorder"
                Grid.Row="1"
                Padding="14,9"
                Margin="0,0,0,10"
                CornerRadius="8"
                BorderThickness="1"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}"
                Visibility="Collapsed">
            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                <TextBlock x:Name="ClassicImportBannerText"
                           DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           Text="📦 Found classic StoreFiles (.stf) in your My StoreFiles folder — upgrade them to StoreTrainer 2.0 (.stfx) while keeping your originals untouched!" />
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Button Content="🪄 Launch StoreFile Upgrade Wizard..."
                            FontWeight="Bold"
                            Padding="12,5"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="OpenUpgradeWizardBannerButton_OnClick"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Launch Classic StoreFile Upgrade Wizard" />
                    <Button Content="Dismiss"
                            Padding="10,5"
                            Click="DismissClassicBannerButton_OnClick"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Dismiss Classic StoreFile Upgrade Banner" />
                </StackPanel>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 2: MAIN TWO-COLUMN SPLIT WORKSPACE (LIBRARY SIDEBAR + EDITOR)
             =================================================================== -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="345" />
                <ColumnDefinition Width="14" />
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ...............................................................
                 LEFT COLUMN: SAVED STOREFILES (.STFX) LIBRARY SIDEBAR
                 ............................................................... -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0"
                    Padding="12"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    BorderThickness="1"
                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                    Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="*" />
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Row 0: New Profile + Open File -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button x:Name="NewProfileButton"
                                Grid.Column="0"
                                Content="➕ New Game Profile"
                                Padding="10,7"
                                FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                Click="NewProfileButton_OnClick"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="Create New Game Profile" />
                        <Button x:Name="ImportProfileButton"
                                Grid.Column="2"
                                Content="📂 Open..."
                                Padding="10,7"
                                Click="ImportProfileButton_OnClick"
                                ToolTip="Open a .stfx profile or upgrade a classic .stf StoreFile"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="Open StoreFile from Computer" />
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Row 1: Dedicated Classic .stf Upgrade Wizard Shortcut -->
                    <Button Grid.Row="1"
                            Content="🪄 Upgrade Classic .stf StoreFiles..."
                            Padding="8,5"
                            Margin="0,0,0,8"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                            Click="OpenUpgradeWizardButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Import classic StoreTrainer 1.0 or 1.1 (.stf) profiles into StoreTrainer 2.0 (.stfx)"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Upgrade Classic StoreFiles Wizard" />

                    <!-- Row 2: Instant Search Box -->
                    <TextBox x:Name="LibrarySearchBox"
                             Grid.Row="2"
                             Padding="8,6"
                             Margin="0,0,0,8"
                             TextChanged="LibrarySearchBox_OnTextChanged"
                             ToolTip="Search saved profiles by game title, category, shortcut keys, or notes"
                             AutomationProperties.Name="Search Saved Game Profiles" />

                    <!-- Row 3: Category & Favorites Filter -->
                    <ComboBox x:Name="LibraryCategoryFilterCombo"
                              Grid.Row="3"
                              SelectedIndex="0"
                              Margin="0,0,0,10"
                              SelectionChanged="LibraryCategoryFilterCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                              AutomationProperties.Name="Filter Saved Profiles by Category">
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="All Saved Profiles" Tag="ALL" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="★ Favorites Only" Tag="FAVORITES" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="General" Tag="General" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Action &amp; Adventure" Tag="Action &amp; Adventure" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Role-Playing (RPG)" Tag="Role-Playing (RPG)" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Strategy &amp; Simulation" Tag="Strategy &amp; Simulation" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Retro &amp; Classic PC" Tag="Retro &amp; Classic PC" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Sports &amp; Racing" Tag="Sports &amp; Racing" />
                    </ComboBox>

                    <!-- Row 4: Scrollable List of Saved .stfx Profiles (with Game .EXE Icons!) -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="4">
                        <ListBox x:Name="ProfilesListBox"
                                 SelectionChanged="ProfilesListBox_OnSelectionChanged"
                                 HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch"
                                 ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
                                 AutomationProperties.Name="Saved StoreFiles List">
                            <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Border Padding="7,7" Margin="0,2">
                                        <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
                                            <!-- Real Game Executable Icon (falls back gracefully when null) -->
                                            <Image DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                   Source="{Binding GameIconSource, TargetNullValue=Assets/StoreTrainer.png}"
                                                   Width="28"
                                                   Height="28"
                                                   Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                   RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality" />
                                            <StackPanel>
                                                <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
                                                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                               Text="{Binding FileNameBadge}"
                                                               FontSize="10.5"
                                                               Opacity="0.65"
                                                               Margin="8,0,0,0"
                                                               VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayTitle}"
                                                               FontSize="13.5"
                                                               FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                                </DockPanel>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding SubtitleSummary}"
                                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                                           Opacity="0.76"
                                                           Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </DockPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        </ListBox>

                        <TextBlock x:Name="EmptyLibraryText"
                                   Text="No saved game profiles yet.&#x0a;&#x0a;Click &quot;➕ New Game Profile&quot; above — or drag and drop any game .exe, trainer .zip, classic .stf, or .stfx file right onto this window!"
                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                   TextAlignment="Center"
                                   Opacity="0.72"
                                   FontSize="12.5"
                                   Margin="18"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   IsHitTestVisible="False"
                                   Visibility="Collapsed" />
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </Border>

            <!-- ...............................................................
                 RIGHT COLUMN: PROFILE EDITOR & DUAL-MODE LAUNCHER
                 ............................................................... -->
            <ScrollViewer Grid.Column="2"
                          VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                          HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                <StackPanel>

                    <!-- TOP ACTION BAR: DUAL LAUNCH (WITH TRAINER / CLEAN) + TOOLS + SAVE -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="ProfileHeaderTitleText"
                                                   Text="Untitled Game Profile"
                                                   FontSize="18.5"
                                                   FontWeight="Bold"
                                                   Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                        <Border x:Name="UnsavedBadgeBorder"
                                                CornerRadius="4"
                                                Padding="7,2"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                Visibility="Collapsed">
                                            <TextBlock Text="Unsaved Changes"
                                                       FontSize="11"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                        </Border>
                                    </WrapPanel>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="PlaytimeStatsText"
                                               Text="Not launched yet"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.75"
                                               Margin="0,3,0,0" />
                                </StackPanel>

                                <CheckBox x:Name="FavoriteCheckBox"
                                          DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                          VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                          Content="★ Favorite"
                                          Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                          Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Pin Profile as Favorite" />
                            </DockPanel>

                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Button x:Name="LaunchNowButton"
                                        Content="▶ Launch with Trainer"
                                        Padding="15,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,8,6"
                                        FontWeight="Bold"
                                        Click="LaunchNowButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Save if needed, create any configured save backup, and launch your game with the selected trainer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Launch Game with Companion Trainer" />
                                <Button x:Name="LaunchCleanButton"
                                        Content="▶ Launch Game Only (No Trainer)"
                                        Padding="13,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,10,6"
                                        Click="LaunchCleanButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Start the game by itself without launching any trainer (great for multiplayer or standard play!)"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Launch Game Only Without Trainer" />
                                <Button x:Name="PopOutCheatCardButton"
                                        Content="🪟 Floating Cheat Card"
                                        Padding="11,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,6"
                                        Click="PopOutCheatCardButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Open a compact Always-On-Top shortcut key card for a second monitor or borderless window"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Open Floating Shortcut Cheat Card" />
                                <Button x:Name="CreateDesktopShortcutButton"
                                        Content="🔗 Desktop Shortcut"
                                        Padding="11,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,10,6"
                                        Click="CreateDesktopShortcutButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Place a 1-click shortcut for this game (with the game's own icon!) on your Windows Desktop"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Create Desktop Game Shortcut" />
                                <Button x:Name="SaveProfileButton"
                                        Content="💾 Save"
                                        Padding="12,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,6"
                                        Click="SaveProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Save Game Profile" />
                                <Button x:Name="SaveAsProfileButton"
                                        Content="Save As..."
                                        Padding="10,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,6"
                                        Click="SaveAsProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Save Game Profile As New File" />
                                <Button x:Name="DuplicateProfileButton"
                                        Content="📋 Duplicate"
                                        Padding="10,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,6"
                                        Click="DuplicateProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Duplicate Game Profile" />
                                <Button x:Name="DeleteProfileButton"
                                        Content="🗑 Delete"
                                        Padding="10,8"
                                        Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                        Click="DeleteProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Delete Game Profile" />
                            </WrapPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- CARD 1: PROFILE NAME, LAUNCH TIMING & RETRO COMPATIBILITY -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="1. Profile Name, Launch Order &amp; Classic Compatibility"
                                       FontSize="15"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,10" />

                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,12">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="2*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Display Title (shown in your library list):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="ProfileDisplayNameBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Profile Display Title" />
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Category:"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="ProfileCategoryCombo"
                                              IsEditable="True"
                                              Padding="8,5"
                                              SelectionChanged="ProfileCategoryCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                              LostFocus="ProfileCategoryCombo_OnLostFocus"
                                              AutomationProperties.Name="Profile Category">
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="General" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Action &amp; Adventure" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Role-Playing (RPG)" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Strategy &amp; Simulation" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Retro &amp; Classic PC" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Sports &amp; Racing" />
                                    </ComboBox>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>

                            <CheckBox x:Name="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox"
                                      Content="Trainer starts the game automatically (only launch the trainer program)"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Trainer Starts the Game Automatically" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="LaunchGameFirstCheckBox"
                                      Content="Start the game first, then open the trainer after the game starts"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Start the Game First Before Trainer" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="WaitForGameReadyCheckBox"
                                      Content="Wait until the first window finishes opening before starting the second program"
                                      IsChecked="True"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Wait Until First Window Finishes Opening" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="AutoCloseTrainerCheckBox"
                                      Content="Automatically close the companion trainer when I exit the game"
                                      IsChecked="True"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Automatically Close Trainer When Game Exits" />

                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,22,4" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Extra pause between programs:"
                                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                               FontSize="12.5"
                                               Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="LaunchDelayCombo"
                                              Width="165"
                                              SelectedIndex="0"
                                              SelectionChanged="LaunchDelayCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                              AutomationProperties.Name="Extra Pause Between Programs">
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="None (0 seconds)" Tag="0" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="2 seconds" Tag="2" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="5 seconds" Tag="5" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="10 seconds" Tag="10" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="15 seconds" Tag="15" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="30 seconds" Tag="30" />
                                    </ComboBox>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,4" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Classic game processor mode:"
                                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                               FontSize="12.5"
                                               Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="CpuCoreLimitCombo"
                                              Width="285"
                                              SelectedIndex="0"
                                              SelectionChanged="CpuCoreLimitCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                              ToolTip="Helps classic late-1990s and early-2000s PC games run at normal speed without audio or physics glitches"
                                              AutomationProperties.Name="Classic Game Processor Mode">
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Use all processor cores (Modern default)" Tag="0" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Single core (Best for 1990s PC classics)" Tag="1" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dual core (Best for early-2000s PC games)" Tag="2" />
                                    </ComboBox>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </WrapPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- CARD 2: GAME PROGRAM (DRAG & DROP GAME .EXE) -->
                    <Border x:Name="GameSectionBorder"
                            Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            AllowDrop="True"
                            Drop="GameSectionBorder_OnDrop"
                            DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False" Margin="0,0,0,8">
